jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an ambitious, high-caliber security leader to serve as our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). This position is ideal for an experienced Deputy CISO ready to step into their first CISO role, or a current CISO early in their head-of-department executive career looking to make a high-impact mark. You will take full ownership of our enterprise security posture, driving modern cybersecurity strategies, risk management, and team leadership in a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Strategy:
Define and execute a modern, scalable enterprise cybersecurity roadmap aligned with core business objectives.
Incident Response & Operations:
Lead the security operations team in threat management, vulnerability assessments, and incident response strategy.
Risk Management & Compliance:
Ensure compliance with applicable industry frameworks, oversight standards, and legal requirements while maintaining a practical risk-tolerance posture.
Board & C-Suite Advisory:
Serve as the strategic security advisor to executive leadership and the Board, communicating complex technical risks in clear business terms.
Team Development:
Build, mentor, and elevate a high-performing security culture, promoting internal talent and modern technical capabilities.

Qualifications

Experience:
Proven track record as a Deputy CISO, VP of Information Security, or early-stage CISO.
Technical Depth & Vision:
Strong background across cloud security, threat governance, identity management, and architecture.
Leadership:
Demonstrated success leading incident response and managing security talent through organizational transitions.
Communication:
Exceptional ability to bridge technical detail with business risk for executive stakeholders.
Location Preference:
Based in or willing to work hybrid within the Philadelphia, PA / Southern New Jersey corridor.

jobs.title: Director of IT
jobs.description:
Emergence Director of IT, Emergence | Remote, U.S.-based | Full-Time

About the role

Emergence is hiring its first dedicated IT hire. This is a foundational role: you will build the portfolio IT function from the ground up, serving as the primary owner of IT across our holding company and portfolio companies. You will work closely with a fractional senior IT/Security advisor who owns the architecture with you, and a managed service provider for day-to-day delivery. You are not expected to run every company's IT — you are expected to know the portfolio well enough to centralize what creates leverage across companies, leave alone what a company already does well, and know the difference.

What you'll do

Acquisition integration
Run the IT workstream for every acquisition: inventory the stack, map access, stand up accounts and devices, wire the company into Emergence systems
Build the Day 1-100 integration playbook this function currently lacks, then run it at roughly three closes a quarter

Identity, access, and operations
Build and operate the joiner/mover/leaver standard across the portfolio, including offboarding completeness
Operate the identity platform after selection and rollout (selection is in-flight, informed by a portfolio audit underway)
Own the living inventory of tools, accounts, admin credentials, licenses, and renewal dates that every consolidation and security decision depends on

Vendors and shared services
Manage the MSP relationship and SLA for portfolio companies that consume central IT delivery
Own vendor contracts, renewals, license consolidation, and portfolio volume pricing
Build the back-end connections that feed our cross-portfolio data platform

Who you are

6-10 years in hands-on IT operations, systems administration, or MSP/consulting delivery, with at least 3 in an IT leadership role
Experience running IT across multiple companies, clients, or business units at once — not a single-company environment, however well run
Experience owning the IT workstream of an acquisition — due diligence, Day 1 readiness, and post-close systems rationalization and migration
Deep understanding of tradeoffs between centralized and decentralized IT delivery; you are a vocal advocate for what works well and what doesn’t
Fluent in identity and access operations (Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, or similar): SSO, provisioning, lifecycle workflows
Comfortable walking into a company with no documentation and systematically mapping what exists
Strong vendor and license management instincts: contracts, renewals, SLAs, consolidation
You build the playbook rather than execute one handed to you
Excellent business stakeholder management skills - you can professionally engage at all levels of the organization

Bonus points

Prior experience in a PE portfolio or holding company
Admin depth in both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 (we run both today)
Experience in regulated segments like healthcare, finance, or defence where compliance is integral to IT operations

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation and a full benefits package. The base salary range for this role is $140,000–$175,000, plus a performance-based bonus. Placement within the range is based on job-related factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Location

Remote, U.S.-based.

jobs.title: VP, Global Technology Services
jobs.description:
About SH/FT

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

The Role

SH/FT is seeking a VP of Global Technology Services to lead and scale our technology delivery practice across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, develops processes with clarity, works cross-functionally by default, and is energized by building client relationships. You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.

This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined playbook. It requires a leader who can move between executive strategy and hands-on execution when it counts, drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority, and bring clarity and momentum to complex, evolving client engagements spanning martech platform configuration to web and email engineering. You'll have real latitude to shape how this practice is structured, staffed, and grown.

What You’ll Lead

Client Delivery and Technical Strategy

Own technology services delivery across active engagements, ensuring technical quality, on-time delivery, and alignment to scope
Serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor to clients, translating complex architecture, engineering, and platform capabilities into clear business outcomes
Step in directly on client work where needed to protect delivery integrity - particularly on the most complex or highest-stakes engagements
Provide thought leadership in RFP and RFI responses, ensuring technical feasibility, clarity, and alignment with best practices
Establish and enforce architectural standards, delivery governance, and quality frameworks across the practice

Practice and Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and retain a team of Directors, senior architects, and engineers across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning
Set standards and best practices for system integrations and email engineering, including responsive design, rendering compatibility, templating architecture, and deployment workflows
Identify opportunities for practice innovation, including accelerators, reusable frameworks, and AI and ML enablement
Partner with Sales and leadership on pipeline development, partnership co-selling, and capability positioning

Cross-Functional Process and Growth

Drive process and operating rhythm across a matrixed, cross-functional team where formal structure is still being built
Partner closely with Sales, Alliances, Business Operations, and Delivery Management to ensure seamless handoffs from pre-sale through execution
Build scalable delivery frameworks, scoping standards, and technical governance models that reduce variability and protect margin across platform and email work
Identify and close operational gaps before they become client or financial issues

What You Bring

Leadership and Delivery

10 or more years in marketing technology, solution architecture, software engineering, or digital consulting, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role (Director or equivalent)
Proven track record leading delivery across multiple complex engagements simultaneously in a consulting or agency environment
Highly comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where process must be built alongside execution
Strong cross-functional influencer who drives alignment without relying on formal authority
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to lead client conversations at the VP and C-Suite level

Technical Expertise

Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the Adobe ecosystem (AEP, AEM, CDP, Marketo, AJO, CJA) or the Salesforce ecosystem (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Account Engage, Agentforce, Sales Cloud), with working fluency across the other-
Strong background in email development, including HTML/CSS email engineering, responsive design, rendering across clients and devices, ESP integrations, and templating frameworks
Broad understanding of enterprise data architecture, identity resolution, and customer 360 strategy
Experience integrating martech platforms with data warehouses, CRMs, CMS platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience with AI and ML enablement across marketing and data platforms

About SH/FT

SH/FT is a client services business that focuses on implementing and activating technology and data to make sales and marketing work. Our people bring combined experience across technology, data and analytics, business strategy, and campaign operations to accelerate our clients' businesses. We keep pace with change in modern marketing and technology in order to create effective, scalable, and future-proof solutions for clients that span both the Fortune 500 and emerging industry leaders. We have built strong relationships with the world's most influential martech platforms and are key partners to them and their clients.

Why SH/FT

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. As VP of Technology Services, you will shape how our clients connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable delivery, and data-driven strategy - and you'll have significant influence over how the practice's structure, standards, and team are shaped and scaled. You will lead a team doing some of the most complex and interesting work in martech today, with a direct line to executive leadership and real influence over where the practice goes next.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current U.S. or Canada work authorization. For U.S. candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be located in North America.

As required by law, SH/FT provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in California, Colorado, Hawaii, New York, New Jersey, or Washington. The salary range for these residents is $185,000.00 to $210,000.00 + annual performance based bonus. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to scope of responsibilities, skillset, relevant experience, certifications, and more. In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

185,000 - 210,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

jobs.description:
Overview

Leads IT support services, end-user support, field support, device support and fulfillment, IT service management, ServiceNow platform support, and service delivery operations across VNS Health. Oversees the performance, quality, and continuous improvement of support services delivered through internal teams and managed support service partners.Serves as a strategic and operational leader for the support experience, ensuring employees, clinicians, field staff, executives, regional offices, and business teams receive reliable, responsive, and consistent technology support. Partners with IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to strengthen support processes, escalation paths, device and asset lifecycle activities, and the end-user experience.Identifies opportunities to responsibly use automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve support operations, ticket routing, knowledge management, training, quality assurance, service reporting, and user experience.Leads and develops support services managers and teams responsible for delivering reliable, consistent, and user-focused technology support across the organization. Accountable for building a capable, service-focused team, strengthening operational discipline, improving documentation and knowledge sharing, and maturing after-hours support, vendor coordination, and service performance.

What We Provide

Referral bonus opportunities
Generous paid time off (PTO), starting at 30 days of paid time off and 9 company holidays
Health insurance plan for you and your loved ones, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability
Employer-matched retirement saving funds
Personal and financial wellness programs
Pre-tax flexible spending accounts (FSAs) for healthcare and dependent care
Generous tuition reimbursement for qualifying degrees
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement
Internal mobility, generous tuition reimbursement, CEU credits, and advancement opportunities

What You Will Do

Contributes to roadmap and capability planning for IT support services, device support, field support, IT service management, and support operations.
Provides leadership and direction for support operations, ensuring services are delivered through well-defined processes, clear ownership, effective governance, and measurable performance.
Partners with technology and business leadership to identify current and future support needs for corporate users, clinicians, field staff, executives, regional offices, and business teams.
Supports modernization and continuous improvement efforts across support operations, devices, ServiceNow workflows, knowledge bases, asset lifecycle processes, and support reporting.
Oversees managed support services, field support, site support, executive support, and workplace support activities across VNS Health locations and user populations.
Ensures day-to-day support services align with VNS Health expectations for service quality, responsiveness, escalation handling, documentation, and user experience.
Monitors service performance, ticket handling, escalation effectiveness, training needs, recurring issues, and opportunities for service improvement.
Ensures clear operational handoffs with support partners, internal teams, vendors, and escalation groups, while providing input on vendor performance, renewal planning, service improvements, and broader vendor strategy.
Oversees support for regional offices, enterprise sites, field operations, office moves, return-to-office activities, executive support, AV/conferencing, print, file, and depot-based support needs.
Establishes and manages escalation, after-hours, and on-call support models, using incident patterns and support activity to identify root causes, process gaps, training needs, and continuous improvement opportunities.
Oversees device support and systems administration functions responsible for L3 technical support, device fleet support, device fulfillment, new hire equipment setups, termination support, and device recovery.
Ensures device support processes are reliable, documented, repeatable, and aligned with standards for security, asset management, compliance, and user experience.
Oversees support for device provisioning, device assignment, equipment shipments, device returns, device wipe/recovery, and coordination with regional support teams and depots.
Partners with Engineering to align support readiness with device standards, configurations, deployment, patching, security controls, and virtual desktop support, while ensuring device and asset management processes remain accurate, controlled, and aligned with ServiceNow and inventory expectations.
Oversees ITSM practices, ServiceNow support, service catalog, reporting, knowledge management, training, quality assurance, and operational performance, ensuring workflows and support processes enable clear ownership, accurate routing, measurable outcomes, and consistent service delivery.
Supports training, quality assurance, and knowledge management practices to support onboarding, coaching, ticket quality, escalation quality, documentation completeness, and support readiness.
Uses service metrics, ticket trends, SLA/KPI reporting, user feedback, and recurring incidents to identify operational risks, knowledge gaps, process issues, and improvement opportunities.
Drives continuous improvement across support services by strengthening documentation, runbooks, handoffs, asset controls, ticket routing, service ownership, automation, and operational maturity.
Evaluates AI-enabled and automation capabilities, identifies practical use cases, leads pilots, and promotes responsible adoption to improve support operations, ticket routing, knowledge management, quality assurance, reporting, self-service, and the end-user experience.
Manages operational relationships with support vendors and service delivery partners, including escalations, quality improvement, issue resolution, performance input, renewal planning, cost considerations, and service improvement opportunities.
Leads, coaches, and develops managers and team members responsible for support services, device support, systems administration, field support, ITSM, ServiceNow support, training, quality assurance, knowledge management, and service performance.
Assigns priorities, monitors progress, manages risks, and ensures quality and consistency of support services deliverables.
Builds leadership and team capability through coaching, mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, cross-training, and performance feedback.
Supports workforce planning, skills development, coverage planning, and succession planning while promoting accountability, collaboration, operational discipline, service ownership, and user-focused support across the support organization.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required

Master's degree in information technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred

Work Experience

Minimum seven years of experience in IT support services, service desk operations, infrastructure support, or enterprise technology service delivery required
Minimum four years of management and people leadership experience required
Experience building, developing, and leading high-performing support or technical teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, skill development, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and continuous improvement required
Experience leading support services in a multi-site or distributed environment, including service desk operations, device support, field support, executive support, device fulfillment, asset lifecycle support, and escalation management required
Experience managing outsourced or vendor-supported service desk operations, including service performance, ticket quality, escalation effectiveness, vendor coordination, and service improvement required
Experience managing after-hours support, escalation processes, and on-call support rotations aligned to business needs required
Experience with ITSM practices and ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, including incident management, request management, knowledge management, service catalog, reporting, dashboards, and workflow improvement required
Experience overseeing device support and device lifecycle operations, including device provisioning, device assignment, new hire setup, termination support, device recovery, inventory control, and depot processes required
Experience developing and maintaining support documentation, knowledge articles, training materials, operational runbooks, escalation procedures, support models, and service ownership practices required
Experience establishing or managing training and quality assurance programs for help desk, technical support, or field support teams required
Experience with change management processes, including change review, risk assessment, implementation planning, communication, and post-change validation required
Experience leading and supporting technology or operational improvement projects, including planning, coordination, execution, stakeholder communication, dependency management, and delivery tracking required
Strong leadership, operational management, problem-solving, communication, documentation, vendor coordination, stakeholder management, planning, and service improvement skills required
Experience with Microsoft technologies, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and related services preferred
Experience in healthcare, clinical support environments, field workforce environments, or highly distributed enterprise environments preferred

Pay Range

USD $137,800.00 - USD $183,800.00 /Yr.

new_jobs.title: VP, Global Technology Services
new_jobs.description:
About SH/FT

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

The Role

SH/FT is seeking a VP of Global Technology Services to lead and scale our technology delivery practice across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, develops processes with clarity, works cross-functionally by default, and is energized by building client relationships. You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.

This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined playbook. It requires a leader who can move between executive strategy and hands-on execution when it counts, drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority, and bring clarity and momentum to complex, evolving client engagements spanning martech platform configuration to web and email engineering. You'll have real latitude to shape how this practice is structured, staffed, and grown.

What You’ll Lead

Client Delivery and Technical Strategy

Own technology services delivery across active engagements, ensuring technical quality, on-time delivery, and alignment to scope
Serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor to clients, translating complex architecture, engineering, and platform capabilities into clear business outcomes
Step in directly on client work where needed to protect delivery integrity - particularly on the most complex or highest-stakes engagements
Provide thought leadership in RFP and RFI responses, ensuring technical feasibility, clarity, and alignment with best practices
Establish and enforce architectural standards, delivery governance, and quality frameworks across the practice

Practice and Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and retain a team of Directors, senior architects, and engineers across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems and web engineering
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning
Set standards and best practices for system integrations and email engineering, including responsive design, rendering compatibility, templating architecture, and deployment workflows
Identify opportunities for practice innovation, including accelerators, reusable frameworks, and AI and ML enablement
Partner with Sales and leadership on pipeline development, partnership co-selling, and capability positioning

Cross-Functional Process and Growth

Drive process and operating rhythm across a matrixed, cross-functional team where formal structure is still being built
Partner closely with Sales, Alliances, Business Operations, and Delivery Management to ensure seamless handoffs from pre-sale through execution
Build scalable delivery frameworks, scoping standards, and technical governance models that reduce variability and protect margin across platform and email work
Identify and close operational gaps before they become client or financial issues

What You Bring

Leadership and Delivery

10 or more years in marketing technology, solution architecture, software engineering, or digital consulting, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role (Director or equivalent)
Proven track record leading delivery across multiple complex engagements simultaneously in a consulting or agency environment
Highly comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where process must be built alongside execution
Strong cross-functional influencer who drives alignment without relying on formal authority
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to lead client conversations at the VP and C-Suite level

Technical Expertise

Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the Adobe ecosystem (AEP, AEM, CDP, Marketo, AJO, CJA) or the Salesforce ecosystem (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Account Engage, Agentforce, Sales Cloud), with working fluency across the other-
Strong background in email development, including HTML/CSS email engineering, responsive design, rendering across clients and devices, ESP integrations, and templating frameworks
Broad understanding of enterprise data architecture, identity resolution, and customer 360 strategy
Experience integrating martech platforms with data warehouses, CRMs, CMS platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience with AI and ML enablement across marketing and data platforms

About SH/FT

SH/FT is a client services business that focuses on implementing and activating technology and data to make sales and marketing work. Our people bring combined experience across technology, data and analytics, business strategy, and campaign operations to accelerate our clients' businesses. We keep pace with change in modern marketing and technology in order to create effective, scalable, and future-proof solutions for clients that span both the Fortune 500 and emerging industry leaders. We have built strong relationships with the world's most influential martech platforms and are key partners to them and their clients.

Why SH/FT

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. As VP of Technology Services, you will shape how our clients connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable delivery, and data-driven strategy - and you'll have significant influence over how the practice's structure, standards, and team are shaped and scaled. You will lead a team doing some of the most complex and interesting work in martech today, with a direct line to executive leadership and real influence over where the practice goes next.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current U.S. or Canada work authorization. For U.S. candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be located in North America.

As required by law, SH/FT provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in California, Colorado, Hawaii, New York, New Jersey, or Washington. The salary range for these residents is $185,000.00 to $210,000.00 + annual performance based bonus. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to scope of responsibilities, skillset, relevant experience, certifications, and more. In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

185,000 - 210,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

new_jobs.title: Director, IT Support Services
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Leads IT support services, end-user support, field support, device support and fulfillment, IT service management, ServiceNow platform support, and service delivery operations across VNS Health. Oversees the performance, quality, and continuous improvement of support services delivered through internal teams and managed support service partners.Serves as a strategic and operational leader for the support experience, ensuring employees, clinicians, field staff, executives, regional offices, and business teams receive reliable, responsive, and consistent technology support. Partners with IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to strengthen support processes, escalation paths, device and asset lifecycle activities, and the end-user experience.Identifies opportunities to responsibly use automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve support operations, ticket routing, knowledge management, training, quality assurance, service reporting, and user experience.Leads and develops support services managers and teams responsible for delivering reliable, consistent, and user-focused technology support across the organization. Accountable for building a capable, service-focused team, strengthening operational discipline, improving documentation and knowledge sharing, and maturing after-hours support, vendor coordination, and service performance.

What We Provide

Referral bonus opportunities
Generous paid time off (PTO), starting at 30 days of paid time off and 9 company holidays
Health insurance plan for you and your loved ones, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability
Employer-matched retirement saving funds
Personal and financial wellness programs
Pre-tax flexible spending accounts (FSAs) for healthcare and dependent care
Generous tuition reimbursement for qualifying degrees
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement
Internal mobility, generous tuition reimbursement, CEU credits, and advancement opportunities

What You Will Do

Contributes to roadmap and capability planning for IT support services, device support, field support, IT service management, and support operations.
Provides leadership and direction for support operations, ensuring services are delivered through well-defined processes, clear ownership, effective governance, and measurable performance.
Partners with technology and business leadership to identify current and future support needs for corporate users, clinicians, field staff, executives, regional offices, and business teams.
Supports modernization and continuous improvement efforts across support operations, devices, ServiceNow workflows, knowledge bases, asset lifecycle processes, and support reporting.
Oversees managed support services, field support, site support, executive support, and workplace support activities across VNS Health locations and user populations.
Ensures day-to-day support services align with VNS Health expectations for service quality, responsiveness, escalation handling, documentation, and user experience.
Monitors service performance, ticket handling, escalation effectiveness, training needs, recurring issues, and opportunities for service improvement.
Ensures clear operational handoffs with support partners, internal teams, vendors, and escalation groups, while providing input on vendor performance, renewal planning, service improvements, and broader vendor strategy.
Oversees support for regional offices, enterprise sites, field operations, office moves, return-to-office activities, executive support, AV/conferencing, print, file, and depot-based support needs.
Establishes and manages escalation, after-hours, and on-call support models, using incident patterns and support activity to identify root causes, process gaps, training needs, and continuous improvement opportunities.
Oversees device support and systems administration functions responsible for L3 technical support, device fleet support, device fulfillment, new hire equipment setups, termination support, and device recovery.
Ensures device support processes are reliable, documented, repeatable, and aligned with standards for security, asset management, compliance, and user experience.
Oversees support for device provisioning, device assignment, equipment shipments, device returns, device wipe/recovery, and coordination with regional support teams and depots.
Partners with Engineering to align support readiness with device standards, configurations, deployment, patching, security controls, and virtual desktop support, while ensuring device and asset management processes remain accurate, controlled, and aligned with ServiceNow and inventory expectations.
Oversees ITSM practices, ServiceNow support, service catalog, reporting, knowledge management, training, quality assurance, and operational performance, ensuring workflows and support processes enable clear ownership, accurate routing, measurable outcomes, and consistent service delivery.
Supports training, quality assurance, and knowledge management practices to support onboarding, coaching, ticket quality, escalation quality, documentation completeness, and support readiness.
Uses service metrics, ticket trends, SLA/KPI reporting, user feedback, and recurring incidents to identify operational risks, knowledge gaps, process issues, and improvement opportunities.
Drives continuous improvement across support services by strengthening documentation, runbooks, handoffs, asset controls, ticket routing, service ownership, automation, and operational maturity.
Evaluates AI-enabled and automation capabilities, identifies practical use cases, leads pilots, and promotes responsible adoption to improve support operations, ticket routing, knowledge management, quality assurance, reporting, self-service, and the end-user experience.
Manages operational relationships with support vendors and service delivery partners, including escalations, quality improvement, issue resolution, performance input, renewal planning, cost considerations, and service improvement opportunities.
Leads, coaches, and develops managers and team members responsible for support services, device support, systems administration, field support, ITSM, ServiceNow support, training, quality assurance, knowledge management, and service performance.
Assigns priorities, monitors progress, manages risks, and ensures quality and consistency of support services deliverables.
Builds leadership and team capability through coaching, mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, cross-training, and performance feedback.
Supports workforce planning, skills development, coverage planning, and succession planning while promoting accountability, collaboration, operational discipline, service ownership, and user-focused support across the support organization.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required

Master's degree in information technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred

Work Experience

Minimum seven years of experience in IT support services, service desk operations, infrastructure support, or enterprise technology service delivery required
Minimum four years of management and people leadership experience required
Experience building, developing, and leading high-performing support or technical teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, skill development, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and continuous improvement required
Experience leading support services in a multi-site or distributed environment, including service desk operations, device support, field support, executive support, device fulfillment, asset lifecycle support, and escalation management required
Experience managing outsourced or vendor-supported service desk operations, including service performance, ticket quality, escalation effectiveness, vendor coordination, and service improvement required
Experience managing after-hours support, escalation processes, and on-call support rotations aligned to business needs required
Experience with ITSM practices and ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, including incident management, request management, knowledge management, service catalog, reporting, dashboards, and workflow improvement required
Experience overseeing device support and device lifecycle operations, including device provisioning, device assignment, new hire setup, termination support, device recovery, inventory control, and depot processes required
Experience developing and maintaining support documentation, knowledge articles, training materials, operational runbooks, escalation procedures, support models, and service ownership practices required
Experience establishing or managing training and quality assurance programs for help desk, technical support, or field support teams required
Experience with change management processes, including change review, risk assessment, implementation planning, communication, and post-change validation required
Experience leading and supporting technology or operational improvement projects, including planning, coordination, execution, stakeholder communication, dependency management, and delivery tracking required
Strong leadership, operational management, problem-solving, communication, documentation, vendor coordination, stakeholder management, planning, and service improvement skills required
Experience with Microsoft technologies, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and related services preferred
Experience in healthcare, clinical support environments, field workforce environments, or highly distributed enterprise environments preferred

We’re one of the largest nonprofit home- and community-based health care organizations in the country, and today, more than 11,500 team members work together to make a difference in the lives of more than 99,000 patients and members on any given day.
